subject: Demo scheduling — need to include security & procurement, request to move slot
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Intro demo request: Redwood for Acme security review

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We'd like to schedule a platform demo focused on security controls, deployment options, and cost profile to share with our infra and procurement teams.

Would Wednesday 16 Jun at 10:00 AM PT work for a 45-minute demo? Attendees would be myself and one product lead. If that time doesn't work we can propose alternatives.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Sr. Product Manager | Acme Inc
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro demo request: Redwood for Acme security review

Hi Samantha — thanks, happy to run this. 10:00 AM PT on June 16 works for me. I'll plan a 45-minute session: 20m demo, 15m security/architecture deep dive, 10m Q&A.

I've attached a short agenda (demo-agenda.pdf). If you anticipate security or procurement representation, please feel free to CC them on this thread and we can invite the appropriate Redwood folks.

Proposed attendees from our side: Rishi (Account Exec), Priyom Das (Platform & Security lead). Let me know if you'd like Monica from Solutions to join.

I'll hold the slot tentatively and send a calendar invite once confirmed.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: demo-agenda.pdf (PDF)
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Mark Jensen <mark.jensen@acme.com>, Laura Procure <laura.procure@acme.com>, Infra Team <infra@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro demo request: Redwood for Acme security review

Thanks Rishi — I looped in Mark (Security), Laura (Procurement), and our infra alias. A couple of conflicts came up: Mark is traveling on the 16th and Laura needs procurement presence to start the commercial conversation. Can we shift so those stakeholders can attend?

Possible windows from our side:
- Thu 17 Jun, 11:00–12:00 PT
- Fri 18 Jun, 13:00–14:00 PT

If neither works we can propose next week. Also Mark asked if you can bring a short slide on network egress and private VPC options — happy to have a short 10-min tech Q&A after the demo.

Sorry for the shuffle — appreciate flexibility.

Samantha
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro demo request: Redwood for Acme security review

No problem — glad they can join. Proposed alternate slots (all PT):
- Thu 17 Jun, 11:00 AM (45m)
- Fri 18 Jun, 1:00 PM (45m)
- Mon 21 Jun, 9:00 AM (45m)

Priyom and Monica are cc'd — Priyom can address security/network architecture and Monica can cover deployment/privates. Priyom, can you confirm availability for those windows and also whether you can cover the 10-min VPC/network slide Mark requested?

Samantha, once you confirm which slot works best I'll send an updated invite and include a short network requirements spreadsheet (network-requirements.xlsx) for your infra team.

Thanks,
Rishi
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro demo request: Redwood for Acme security review

Hi all — I can join and cover the security/network portion. Available windows look OK; prefer Fri 18 Jun 1:00 PM PT. I will prepare a 5–8 slide appendix on VPC/network egress and bring the network-requirements.xlsx to the call. Monica, lmk if you'd like me to hand off the deployment run-through to you.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Platform Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Mark Jensen <mark.jensen@acme.com>, Laura Procure <laura.procure@acme.com>, Infra Team <infra@acme.com>, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro demo request: Redwood for Acme security review

Fri 18 Jun 1:00 PM PT works for everyone here. Please go ahead and send the calendar invite and include the short agenda and network spreadsheet. We'll plan for 50 minutes to give time for procurement questions at the end.

Appreciate the quick coordination — see you then.

-Samantha
